name: Taruni Nallamothu
tagline: AI/ML Engineer & Data Engineer · Google, Microsoft & AWS Certified · Generative AI, RAG & Scalable Data Platforms
bio: I build Generative AI, RAG, and data engineering systems that turn enterprise data into decisions people can trust. At Hansvonlehwalt, I build RAG pipelines and agentic multi-agent workflows with Azure OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph and MCP for enterprise knowledge retrieval. At Tata Consultancy Services, I engineered data and ML pipelines on Azure Databricks processing 500GB+ of enterprise data daily across 1M+ validated records.
summary: AI/ML Engineer, Data Scientist and Data Engineer with over five years of professional experience, more than three of them building data pipelines, predictive machine learning models and Generative AI applications in Python. At Tata Consultancy Services, built Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Databricks and PySpark pipelines on a medallion architecture and tuned classification and time series forecasting models. In the current role, builds Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and agentic, multi-agent LLM workflows with Azure OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph and Model Context Protocol (MCP), exposes them through FastAPI services, and packages and tracks them with Docker, Kubernetes and MLflow. Also brings model evaluation, MLOps and LLMOps, observability, data governance, NLP and stakeholder-facing analytics, and holds an MSc in Data Science (Distinction) from the University of Hertfordshire and the AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer certification.
obsession: Currently, I'm obsessed with making LLM systems boring in the best way — grounded, observable, and reliable enough to trust in production, not just a demo.
